model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
proof_types.TransferReceipt: {issuer:M05,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,root_manifest_ids,external_proof_id,Context,receipt_id}; original Held transitions only after verified durable catalog commit.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.LocalIntegrityReady: Native coherent recovery index+payload+ALL material copies and hashes/schema verified; independent from original catalog availability.
recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. Destination import+durable pin+M04 new-unsaved install mandatory; original Held/Unknown retained and no fake original Published/ACK. Missing/corrupt local blob always blocks.

reservation_kinds.FormalWriteReservation: blocks same-owner content edits until matching IO completion; read diagnostics allowed.
reservation_kinds.RecoveryAttemptReservation: one recovery attempt; after immutable capture+pin, live healthy owner may edit. Never reuse formal saving state for whole recovery copy pipeline.
reservation_kinds.CatalogLease: short transition only, no callbacks into document owner while held.
